description: Change of use from retail shop (Use class E) to  Banqueting Hall (Use class Sui Generis)
decision_conditions: <span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="height:13.1pt"><span calibri="">The proposed submission in the&nbsp;absence of&nbsp;a </span><span calibri="">Travel Plan, Transport Statement, Vehicular/Cycle Parking Design and Management Plans, Construction Logistics Plan and Delivery and Servicing Plans and/or on-site provision for general waste, lacks the necessary level of information to enable officers to make an informed decision over the impacts of the proposal upon public transport, the highway network, the cycle network and upon conditions for pedestrian<span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">s, </span></span></span><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">occupants or nearby residents.</span><span style="height:13.1pt"><span calibri="">&nbsp;This element of the proposal, as submitted is contrary to</span></span><span calibri="">&nbsp;the <em>‘National Planning Policy Framework’ </em>(2024),</span><span style="height:13.1pt"><span calibri="">&nbsp;Policies T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T6.5, T7 of the ‘<em>London Plan’</em> (2021); policies CS1.Q, CS1.R,&nbsp;CS1.X of the ‘<em>Core Strategy’</em> (2012)&nbsp;and Policies DM2, DM42, DM43, DM44 and DM45 of the London Borough of Harrow Council’s ‘<em>Development Management Policies’.</em></span></span></span>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed submission, absent of existing and proposed side elevations, roof plan, first floor plan, lacks the necessary level of information to enable officers to make an informed decision over whether reasonable steps had been taken to secure a safe,&nbsp;and sustainable design and layout, in particular to the way it is accessed or functions, and/or the resulting relationship with end users, its surroundings and impact on neighbouring occupiers, fails to adhere with the requirement of Policies D3, D5 ,D11 and D12 of the ‘London Plan’ (2021); Policies DM1, DM2 and DM12 of the London Borough of Harrow Council’s ‘Development Management Policies’ (2013), Policy CS1 of The ‘Core Strategy’ (2012) and requirements of Article 9A of The Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015.</span></span></p>

<span style="font-size:11pt">The proposed submission, in the absence of&nbsp;an Odour Assessment for the proposed installation of the extract flue and fan and the mitigation measures proposed, lacks the necessary level of information to enable officers to make an informed decision over the potential harm caused to nearby residents by virtue of air pollution. This element of the proposal, as submitted, fails to adhere to paragraphs&nbsp;187(e) and 198 of the ‘<em>National Planning Policy Framework’ (</em>2024), and the requirements of Policies D3 D(7)(9) and&nbsp;SI1(B)(1)(2) of the ‘<em>London Plan’</em> (2021) and&nbsp;Policies DM1(D)(h), DM12(A)(d) and DM37(d) of the London Borough of Harrow Council’s ‘<em>Development Management Policies’</em> (2013).</span>

<span style="font-size:11pt">The proposed submission, in the absence&nbsp;of&nbsp;a Noise Impact Assessment (including a Noise Management Plan) for the intended use and its opening hours, lacks the necessary level of information to enable officers to make an informed decision over the potential harm caused to nearby residents by virtue of noise pollution and general disturbance. Therefore, in the absence of sufficient information, the proposal as submitted, fails to adhere with Paragraphs&nbsp;187(e) and 198 of the ‘<em>National Planning Policy Framework’</em> (2024) and the requirements of Policies&nbsp;D3(D)(7)(9), D13 and D14 of the ‘<em>London Plan’</em> (2021) and Policies DM1(D)(h), DM12(A)(d) and DM37(d) of the London Borough of Harrow Council’s ‘<em>Development Management Policies’</em> (2013).</span>
